issues.quote: operating cash flow climbed to $118.5 billion in fiscal 2024 from $111.8 billion a year earlier
issues.problem: Microsoft's fiscal 2023 operating cash flow was about $87.6 billion, not $111.8 billion. Growth was about 35%.

data.summary: One figure is wrong: fiscal 2023 operating cash flow was about $87.6 billion, not $111.8 billion. All other figures are correct. The fact sheet's +21.8% net income growth is right when calculated from the unrounded figures ($88,136 million vs. $72,361 million). The 21.7% comes from rounding.
